subject: QuantAvenue — Dedicated capacity demo intake and availability
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@quantavenue.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Self-signup: Dedicated capacity demo request

Hi Sergio,

We just self-signed for a Dedicated capacity evaluation and I saw your SDR flow suggest a quick intake. We're trying to validate capacity planning before procurement.

High-level requirements:
- Peak concurrent requests: ~2,000 qps (in spikes)
- Expected steady-state: ~800 qps
- Target latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token context
- Typical prompt length: 200-400 tokens; embeddings + reranking downstream
- Data residency: US

Would like a 45 min walkthrough this week focused on throughput, autoscale behavior, and fallback strategies. Karina (cc'd) will own procurement questions.

Thanks,

Alex Wu
Head of Platform
QuantAvenue

Attachments: selfsignup-confirmation.pdf (stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@quantavenue.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup: Dedicated capacity demo request

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the details — that helps a lot. We can definitely structure a 45-minute session focused on Dedicated capacity sizing and latency SLOs. Proposed agenda:
1) Quick intro & goals (5 min)
2) Expected workload walk-through (you) (10 min)
3) Serving architecture + dedicated pool behavior (Ben) (15 min)
4) Autoscaling/fallback and SLA discussion (Soojin) (10 min)
5) Next steps / procurement checklist (5 min)

Two quick asks before we lock time:
- Can you confirm steady-state token/sec estimates and whether you plan to use streaming? 
- Any redline or security docs we should review ahead of time?

I attached a short intake checklist that helps our solutions folks size the pool. Pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/45min — I'm free Wednesday and Thursday mornings PST.

Cheers,

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dedicated_capacity_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Karina Morales <kmorales@quantavenue.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@quantavenue.io>
Date: 2027-12-05T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup: Dedicated capacity demo request

Thanks Sergio — we can do Wednesday 2027-12-08 at 11:00 AM PST.

Couple of clarifications from our infra team:
- Avg tokens/sec per request ~120; average requests/sec target 800; bursts to 2k for ~10-20s
- P95 budget 150–200ms for generation only (reranker latency excluded)
- We will use streaming for long generations

I've attached our internal SLA/requirements doc (quantavenue-sla-requirements.docx). We'll include our infra lead on the call if there are deep ops questions.

Karina Morales
Director, Procurement
QuantAvenue

Attachments: quantavenue-sla-requirements.docx (stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Karina Morales <kmorales@quantavenue.io>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@quantavenue.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-07T17:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup: Dedicated capacity demo request — confirmed

Hi Karina/Alex — confirmed for Wed 12/08 11:00 AM PST. Calendar invite attached (demo-invite.ics).

Final agenda (45m):
- 0–5m: Intros & goals
- 5–15m: Your workload & burst patterns (Alex)
- 15–30m: Dedicated runtime architecture + batching/kv-cache behavior (Ben)
- 30–40m: Autoscale policy, fallback to hosted variants, and latency tradeoffs (Soojin)
- 40–45m: Procurement checklist + next steps (Kimberly)

Pre-read: dedicated-demo-agenda.pdf attached — includes a one-page checklist for telemetry we ask you to share (sample traces/percentiles, token distribution).

If you need to move the time, reply with two alternative windows. Otherwise we'll send a calendar invite and a short sandbox access link for a preliminary throughput test.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Sergio

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
